messages:
maya: kicking off canary for api-v2 now. feature flag `ff_chat_routing` will be ramped 0 -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% across 4 steps. plan: 5m settle, 10m, 10m, final verification. quiet window 02:00-04:00 PST, release notes at https://ourwiki/release/api-v2-canary :eyes:
deploy-bot: scheduled: api-v2 canary started by maya at 2025-11-03T02:05:00Z. applying ff_chat_routing=5% on region=us-west1. monitor: latency P95, 5xx rate, token-cost delta.
liam: oncall monitoring - I'll join Zoom and watch traces. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (monitoring pod: #canary-watch)
sara: added perf smoke to the runbook: check `tail -f /var/log/inference/proxy.log | grep ERROR` and `curl -s -D - http://canary/api/health`
maya: pinning model version to v2-rc3 for this rollout. jon can you confirm DB migrations are not in this deploy?
jon: no migrations. just routing + small config.
deploy-bot: toggle applied: ff_chat_routing=5% · instances affected=12 · rollout_id=rb-7512
liam: seeing slight p95 bump (+30ms) at t+6m. still within SLO. 5xx=0.02%
sara: cost spike observed in embeddings calls, looks correlated with routing to gen-backend. sending perf trace to #observability.
maya: hold next step for 5m while we validate cost and traces. if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 increase >150ms we abort. otherwise continue. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: waiting for manual approval to proceed to 25% — use `/deploybot continue rb-7512` or `/deploybot abort rb-7512`
liam: /deploybot continue rb-7512 — proceeding to 25%
deploy-bot: toggle applied: ff_chat_routing=25% · instances affected=48
sara: after 25% there's a small uptick in L7 retries, investigating. tagging @maya.
maya: we keep ramp paused. jon — can you toggle routing fallback to standby on gen-backend if retries exceed threshold?
jon: yes, can push fallback policy 2. rolling now via config mgmt: `cfgctl set routing.gen-backend.fallback=standby --env=canary`
ops-bot: alert suppression: muting non-critical alerts for rb-7512 for next 20m per rollout window
liam: after fallback applied p95 back to baseline, 5xx steady. recommend continue.
maya: ok proceed to 100% but with a 10m cooldown after 50% step. we want a final sanity check in Zoom.
deploy-bot: performing 50% ramp step now. ff_chat_routing=50%
sara: logs look good. no new errors.
liam: rolling to 100% in 10m if no regressions. I'm staying on watch.
maya: if at any point 5xx > 0.5% or error budget burn > 20% in 10m — rollback plan: immediate `/deploybot abort rb-7512` then `/deploybot set-flag ff_chat_routing off` and pin traffic back to v1.
jen: (note) adding release notes snippet: "api-v2 routing enabled behind feature flag ff_chat_routing; canary ramped Nov 3; no DB changes."
ops-bot: deploy summary: rollout rb-7512 completed 100% at 2025-11-03T02:55:00Z. final metrics: p95 +18ms, 5xx 0.03%, cost delta +2.1%.
maya: thanks team. leaving monitor for 30m then will close the ticket. tagging @oncall for handoff. :white_check_mark:
liam: handoff ack. I'll stay until +30m.
sara: pushing short postmortem template to the thread in 1h if anything to surface.
maya: closing thread after soak. great coordination. :clap:
